title: Admin could incur a loss with debt settlement
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, admin will incur a loss as he will pay more than required to settle debts  **Likelihood:** Medium, occurs when admin settles debt  ## Description  An admin of LidoVault can perform a debt settlement to end the vault early due to unexpected issues with Lido. The process is initiated using `initiatingAdminSettleDebt()` with the `adminSettleDebtAmount` paid by admin in ETH.
